channel.title: LoomSci - Artificial Intelligence
channel.description: Latest Artificial Intelligence articles from LoomSci

item.title: Why LLMs Can’t See Cause—and How Interventional Agents Find It
item.description: Large language models mathematically cannot infer causation from passive data, but interventional agents using Bayesian optimization can discover causal structure from active queries.

item.title: Teaching Machines the Echoes Between Atoms: Topology for Polymer Design
item.description: Polymers underpin applications across energy, healthcare, and materials science, yet their vast chemical space makes systematic discovery challenging. Most machine learning approaches represent polymers as molecular graphs of a single repeating unit, thereby missing...

item.title: Learning to Evolve: Strategy Genes Outperform Skills
item.description: Compact, gene-like memory guides AI agents to outperform verbose skill packages in scientific coding, revealing that representation structure matters more than raw information.

item.title: Seeing Without Sight: The Emergent Imagery of Language Models
item.description: Large language models trained only on text can outperform humans at spatial mental imagery tasks, suggesting language alone may enable a form of artificial phantasia.

item.title: The Network That Learned to Tell Stories
item.description: By breaking symmetry in Hopfield networks, scientists achieve superpolynomial sequence memory, allowing neural nets to store vast libraries of long, robust story-like cycles.

item.title: The Network That Taught Itself Grammar
item.description: Training a neural network to predict words far into the future causes its internal representations to spontaneously organize into grammatical categories like nouns, verbs, and adjectives.

item.title: When Impossibility Becomes a Blueprint for Trustworthy AI
item.description: The deterministic horizon of transformer architectures defines an information-theoretic ceiling for reasoning depth, turning an impossibility into a constructive design constraint for trustworthy AI.
